## Claims
- [source-backed] RWY work integrally in \(\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\) and prove that \(J_v\) is generated by two Schur-interval families; their proof uses Pieri identities and induction, not a stated Smith-form or unimodular-minor theorem. [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 828-892; 1009-1041; 1068-1142]
- [source-backed] St. Dizier–Yong define \(\overline{\Lambda}=\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\), with \(\overline{s}_\lambda\overline{s}_\mu=\sum_{\nu\subseteq(n-r)^r}c_{\lambda,\mu}^{\nu}\overline{s}_\nu\), and prove lower-adjoined-family minimality using LR linear equations and coproduct reduction. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 213-235; 263-304; 494-516]
- [source-backed] The stated St. Dizier–Yong algorithm is a terminating tensor reduction for valid \((n,r,i,j,a,b,N)\), not a theorem about integer Pieri presentation matrices, determinantal divisors, Smith diagonals, or complementary minors. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 494-516; 598-632]

## Strategy
The required target concerns degreewise integral Pieri matrices for the Schur interval
\[
i^j\subseteq\lambda\subseteq(n-r)^r
\]
and certificates such as a unit determinant, a unimodular minor, determinantal divisors, or Smith normal form.

The supplied provider search executed only the literal query set `persisted:source-39,source-29,source-30`. Its three candidates were the 2022/2024 St. Dizier–Yong paper (two renderings of the same work) and RWY (2011); it did not execute targeted external/arXiv queries containing “Smith normal form,” “determinantal divisors,” “unimodular minors,” or their combinations with “Pieri matrix,” “Schur functions,” or “Littlewood–Richardson.”

Comparison: RWY supplies integral Schur/Pieri generation, while St. Dizier–Yong supplies lower-family minimality through LR/Hopf methods. Neither cited statement supplies the requested matrix hypotheses or any determinant, unit, Smith diagonal, or determinantal-divisor value.

## Gaps
The requested targeted literature-search certificate is **not established**: no supplied evidence records the required targeted external/arXiv keyword search. The only justified negative result is bounded to the two inspected works above; it is not a negative claim about broader literature. No determinant or finite matrix witness is applicable because no candidate theorem concerning such a matrix was located by the executed provider query.

## Next
A separate certificate would require an executed targeted search with the specified Smith/determinantal-divisor/unimodular-minor/Pieri query combinations and full-text inspection of plausible results.
